251523|14e578ce.name: Constable Aonda
251523|14e578ce.text: <Constable Aonda wears an intense look on her face, clearly deep in thought.>

251662|18bda9db.name: Living Lightning
251662|18bda9db.text: <The roiling cloud of living lightning before you seems to crackle menacingly as you approach. It might be best to leave. Quickly.>

251905|3541aa81.name: Zerril Softbreeze
251905|3541aa81.text: If you need training as a cook, I have a few tips and tricks I could pass on! Ho ho! Throw on an apron and let's get started!

251992|f5ff5fa7.name: Fenn Fairweather
251992|f5ff5fa7.text: Welcome to Shen'dar Village, some of the best fishing this side of the mountain range. If you are looking to catch fish, I can teach you, for a price.

252068|7763c9f1.name: Al'Aketh Stormcaller
252068|7763c9f1.text: The Windlord's blessings flow through me!

252068|8cd3381f.name: Al'Aketh Stormcaller
252068|8cd3381f.text:
Why are you bothering me, recruit? If you want to talk to other doe-eyed fools, try the inn on the north side of town. The recruits that congregate there tend to have brains as smooth as their freshly shaved heads.

Oh, and shave that head of yours. The only thing the windlord abhors more than chatty recruits is chatty recruits with a full head of hair.

Now, be gone from my sight.

252068|a66e8a24.name: Al'Aketh Stormcaller
252068|a66e8a24.text: Does your heart beat in rhythm with the winds?

252068|b26bb011.name: Al'Aketh Stormcaller
252068|b26bb011.text: Are you new here? I have nothing to say to unshaven recruits save that you should sublimate your youthful eagerness into supplication and prayer.

252359|80b579b6.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
252359|80b579b6.text: Our kind are rare these days, but there are those who still dream in emerald amongst the Shen'dorei.

252448|aadf0ebc.name: Alvarion Windfield
252448|aadf0ebc.text: <The man lying before you shifts uncomfortably. He's recovering from some very nasty wounds.>

252477|28030f47.name: Peacekeeper Elite
252477|28030f47.text: You can find the cooking trainer in a small house on the north end of town.

252477|8b1fd97e.name: Peacekeeper Elite
252477|8b1fd97e.text: What are you looking for, citizen?

253474|37e215b2.name: Peacekeeper
253474|37e215b2.text: Which class trainer are you looking for?

253474|aa6ba0a9.name: Peacekeeper
253474|aa6ba0a9.text: Is there something I can help you find?

253474|ba9ef707.name: Peacekeeper
253474|ba9ef707.text: You'll find Lotheluum Starbreeze on a cliff overlooking the waterfall on the eastern edge of town.

254100|157bb7b8.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|157bb7b8.text:
Have you seen them? The skycutters are running again! I've heard that we still have no contact with the other shen'dorei islands, though.

I hope we re-establish contact with Shen'dramar and Eldranaar soon... if they are even still out there.

254100|609c70df.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|609c70df.text: The Windshapers and the High Order are up to something. There are rumors floating around that both groups plan to get the skycutters running again and use them to leave the Skywall. LEAVE SKYWALL? How ridiculous. Where would they even go?

254100|c97861a8.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|c97861a8.text:
Be wary of anyone you meet with grey robes and a shaved head. They call themselves the Al'Aketh, and they are a menace. 

I even heard that they've been doing things to the anchor pylons around the island.

If the Windshapers are to be believed, those pylons are the only thing keeping Zephras afloat here in the elemental plane. It would be madness to tamper with them!

254128|8cbd94ac.name: Wardrobe
254128|8cbd94ac.text: <The two cultists nearby are talking. You might be able to learn something if you hide behind this wardrobe and eavesdrop.>

254345|8185bcbc.name: Syriel Nightrain
254345|8185bcbc.text: Kaelsig Veldbarad, ras. Y wirsh odes barad me ko tiras ko lo ash se faergas Y gol majis nud me o mod engoth aelgestron.

255940|9cc50b7d.name: Donaal Downbreeze
255940|9cc50b7d.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

256076|f046599c.name: Damaged Construct
256076|f046599c.text: <A faint whirring sound can be heard coming from underneath the construct's metal armor plates. The wind powering this machine is present but is listless and only faintly churning. You don't need to know much about air constructs to know that this unit is clearly not in good repair.>

257003|1a6886aa.name: Ishlee Breezewhisper
257003|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

257004|fb513610.name: Eaysaa Brightgust
257004|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause. I was in the middle of some important work.

257005|d62b45b0.name: Valiena Swiftgale
257005|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

257006|53a09e6f.name: Nyalah Brightfire
257006|53a09e6f.text: Y garde bor hir uden algos me nuff nostyec lon aldonoth, far Y nagan Y borne eynes nud danagarde lo rothas melka.

257006|8fa53a5b.name: Nyalah Brightfire
257006|8fa53a5b.text:
Cooking on Zephras may seem difficult to the untrained eye, but I enjoy the creation of every dish. Even though our dwindling home is lacking many of our traditional kaldorei ingredients, it has been fun to create new variations of the recipes of our ancestors.

I hope that no matter where the winds take you, these recipes remind you of home.

257008|2d37e4b8.name: Baelann Swiftcurrent
257008|2d37e4b8.text: Me, o ealdor Veldbarad. Bor nud faergas me thor se o daegil aldonoth? Majis Y gol nuff nud o algos se ash?

257022|5c2244b7.name: Messana Crestwind
257022|5c2244b7.text:
You might think that just because we live on a floating island, there would be no need for miners like me. After so many thousands of years, however, we still manage to dig up a lot of interesting things.

It's almost like there's some invisible force, constantly creating new mineral deposits every so often. That's magic for you though, right?

Regardless, if you need training as a miner, then I'm your shen'dorei.

257036|a6bb08a8.name: Baelann Favorbreeze
257036|a6bb08a8.text: Welcome to the Bank of Valanaar. We can secure your belongings and valuables here should you so desire. Do you wish to access your deposit box?

257065|819f44a1.name: Missionary Jasaan
257065|819f44a1.text: Do you seek the blessings of the Windlord?

271465|92b9fbbb.name: Falfaan Halfwind
271465|92b9fbbb.text:
Greetings, $c. Are you in need of arms?

I was trained by Antarion of Ban'aethal, using secrets handed down from the ancient master magesmiths of Kalimdor.

You'll find no finer weapons on Zephras Isle than mine.

92528-accept.name: Missionary Jasaan
92528-accept.text:
The faithful of Al'Akir grow ever stronger with each eager new recruit like yourself. As you can see, our strength gives form to the storm itself!

Normally I'd send you straight to Skypriest Aanders for assessment, but he is occupied at present receiving a guest at the inn on the north side of town. Please avoid that place for now. An unshaven recruit like yourself in the presence of such a guest would be inappropriate.

For now, just don't get in anyone's way.
92528-accept.title: Among the Faithful

92528-complete.name: Constable Aonda
92528-complete.text:
Lorthuna herself was there? She's the leader of the whole damned cult!

If they are making a move on Shen'dar Village and the western watchtower, we've got to be ready. What is strange is... why the watchtower?

The Village I can understand, but the tower? It doesn't have much strategic significance, other than as a minor lookout post.

Regardless, we will be prepared for them. They'll find that highlanders aren't as easy to catch flat footed as they might think.
92528-complete.title: Among the Faithful

92529-complete.name: Missionary Jasaan
92529-complete.text:
What is this? A new acolyte seeking to serve the windlord sent by sister Sania? Truly we are blessed by the touch of the four winds this day!

We welcome all who seek to bask in the blessings of Al'Akir.
92529-complete.title: Falaath Village

92550-accept.name: Constable Aonda
92550-accept.text:
Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.
92550-accept.title: Havoc in the Highlands

92551-accept.name: Danarii Bellowveil
92551-accept.text:
I overheard you might be going to Falaath Village? While you are there, please keep an eye out for our stolen supply caches.

The Al'Aketh have been raiding our supply caravans carrying various goods such as food and windstones to and from the lowlands for months. They've been blaming the bandits, of course, but we all know that it all ends up in the same place. If there's any of that stuff left in Falaath, it would be a huge help if you could recover it.
92551-accept.title: Stolen Supplies

92679-accept.name: Alvarion Windfield
92679-accept.text:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The $R man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
92679-accept.title: Blood Tithe

93926-accept.name: Constable Aonda
93926-accept.text:
Whatever reason the cult has for attacking the tower, it's not worth losing our people over.

I'd like for you to head to the southwest and check in on that watchtower for us. Find the peacekeepers there and tell them to head back to the village. Holding that tower is not worth the lives it would cost and I'd rather concentrate the defenders we do have here to protect our citizens.

Peacekeeper Vaaniel is in charge; let him know to head back here as quickly as possible. Hurry!
93926-accept.title: The Western Watch

94484-accept.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
94484-accept.text:
A moment if you will, $N. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a $c conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.

With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able, go seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.
94484-accept.title: Unnerving Silence

97967-complete.name: Fenn Fairweather
97967-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97967-complete.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97970-complete.name: Messana Crestwind
97970-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Lodestone. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97970-complete.title: Camping 101: Mining
